Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance

Claim Notes
Claim number:

2025-04-02
Claim reported by the insured's policyholder after a side impact at a signalized intersection. The vehicle was struck on
the driver's side by a vehcile that entered on a red signal, and a tow was arranged from the scene.
2025-04-26
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force on the date of loss. Coverage
questions are closed for now.
2025-04-27
Claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office. Requested the police
report and the scene photographs.
2025-05-09
Police report received. The responding officer noted the claimant was in the vehicle and recorded the same sqeuence
of evetns the claimant described when first contacted.
2025-05-19
Took statements from two independent witnesses. Both describe the impact as I was told, and neither has any
connection to the parties involved.
2025-07-31
Reviewed the photographs and the damage estimate. The location and pattern of the damage match the side impact
described, and no older damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection records.
2025-08-31
The other driver's statement matches the account given by the claimant and the witnesses on how the collision
happened.
2025-09-18
The claimant reported a concusison with headaches and dizziness. The reported symptoms are plausible for a
collision of this type, and I found no record of earlier injury to the head or neck.
2025-10-03
Medical records received from the treating providers. Care followed a typical course of evaluation, imaging, and
follow-up visits, with symptoms easing steadily as the claimant recovered.
2025-10-09
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who confirmed the account and provided the treatment timeline. The claimant's
description of events has stayed consistent in every conversation so far.
2025-10-17
Reviewed the treatment summary against the records already on file. Visit frequency has tapered as symptoms
improved, which is consistent with the recovery reported by the providers.
2025-10-18
File assessed as complete for the current stage. Injury and property elements are supported by the evidence, and the
next step is to finalize the settlement evaluation with counsel.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
